js: (async()=>{document.querySelector('[data-im="tasks-entry"]').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const card=document.querySelector('[data-im="intent"][data-docked="1"]');const id=card?card.getAttribute('data-intent-id'):null;const nodes=id?[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-im="preview"][data-intent-id="'+id+'"]')].map(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {cls:e.className,w:Math.round(r.width),h:Math.round(r.height),x:Math.round(r.x),y:Math.round(r.y)}}):[];const vis=nodes.filter(n=>n.w>0&&n.h>0);const strip=card?card.getBoundingClientRect():null;return JSON.stringify({id,vis,strip:strip?{x:Math.round(strip.x),y:Math.round(strip.y),w:Math.round(strip.width),h:Math.round(strip.height)}:null,within:strip?strip.x>=0&&strip.y>=0&&strip.right<=window.innerWidth&&strip.bottom<=window.innerHeight:null})})()
